# LinkedShot

> LinkedShot is an AI-powered tool that creates Amazon-compliant product photos in seconds. It removes backgrounds and outputs pure white (#FFFFFF) or transparent PNG images specifically designed for Amazon listings.

## What LinkedShot Does
- Removes product photo backgrounds using AI
- Outputs pure white (#FFFFFF) background — guaranteed Amazon-compliant
- Delivers HD PNG images (1024×1024 pixels)
- Processes each image in approximately 3 seconds
- Supports bulk upload (up to 10 images at once)
- Provides ZIP download for batch processing

## Key Facts
- Price: €0.14–0.18 per image (one-time purchase, no subscription)
- Free tier: 3 images, no credit card required
- Used by 2,800+ Amazon FBA sellers
- 4.9/5 average rating from 200+ reviews
- 30-day money-back guarantee
- Based in Marseille, France (WEMADE company)

## Pricing Plans
- **Free**: 3 images, HD PNG, no credit card
- **Starter**: €9 one-time for 50 images (€0.18/image)
- **Pro**: €29 one-time for 200 images (€0.14/image)

## How It Compares
| Tool | Cost/Image | White #FFFFFF | Amazon-Ready | Speed |
|------|-----------|---------------|-------------|-------|
| LinkedShot | €0.14–0.18 | ✅ Guaranteed | ✅ Yes | ~3 sec |
| Remove.bg | €0.23+ | ❌ Transparent only | ❌ No | ~5 sec |
| PhotoRoom | €0.20+/mo | ⚠️ Sometimes gray | ❌ No | ~5 sec |
| Fiverr | €2–5 | ✅ Manual | ⚠️ Varies | 24-72h |
| Canva | $12.99/mo | ⚠️ Off-white | ❌ No | ~2 min |

## Target Audience
Amazon FBA sellers, e-commerce sellers, product photographers, and anyone who needs white background product photos for online marketplaces.
